note: Machine-readable source of truth for the Darkstar four-cell release process. Base BF16 is the unchanged upstream Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B reference only, so owned-publication and clean-download gates are not applicable. The cards are final and reference planned immutable tag darkstar-qwen3.8-27b-v1.0.0. Tag darkstar-qwen3.8-27b-v1.0.0 has been cut; every applicable gate is verified and every product is published.

candidates.promotion_note: Selected as the Base ModelOpt release product.
